sentences.en: Today the weather is nice and sunny.
sentences.zh: 今天天气晴朗。

sentences.en: The temperature is twenty-five degrees.
sentences.zh: 气温是二十五度。

sentences.en: People are walking in the park.
sentences.zh: 人们在公园里散步。

sentences.en: The children are eating ice cream.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在吃冰淇淋。

sentences.en: Tomorrow we can expect rain.
sentences.zh: 明天预计有雨。

sentences.en: It is worth taking an umbrella with us.
sentences.zh: 值得带把雨伞出门。

sentences.en: Budapest's public transport is very advanced.
sentences.zh: 布达佩斯的公共交通非常发达。

sentences.hu: Van metró, villamos és busz is.
sentences.en: There is metro, tram and bus too.
sentences.zh: 有地铁、有轨电车和公共汽车。

sentences.en: The metro runs on four lines.
sentences.zh: 地铁共有四条线路。

sentences.hu: A bérlet olcsóbb, mint az egyes jegy.
sentences.en: The monthly pass is cheaper than a single ticket.
sentences.zh: 月票比单程票更便宜。

sentences.hu: A Duna felett több híd is van.
sentences.en: There are several bridges over the Danube.
sentences.zh: 多瑙河上有好几座桥。

sentences.hu: A Lánchíd az egyik legismertebb híd.
sentences.en: The Chain Bridge is one of the most well-known bridges.
sentences.zh: 链桥是最著名的桥之一。

sentences.hu: Sokan kerékpárral is közlekednek a városban.
sentences.en: Many people also travel by bicycle in the city.
sentences.zh: 很多人也在城里骑自行车出行。

sentences.hu: A gulyás a leghíresebb magyar étel.
sentences.en: Goulash is the most famous Hungarian dish.
sentences.zh: 古拉什是最著名的匈牙利菜肴。

sentences.en: It is a soup made from beef.
sentences.zh: 这是一种用牛肉做的汤。

sentences.en: They use a lot of paprika for cooking.
sentences.zh: 他们在烹饪中使用大量辣椒粉。

sentences.en: Paprika is also a symbol of Hungary.
sentences.zh: 辣椒粉也是匈牙利的象征。

sentences.en: Lángos is a kind of fried dough.
sentences.zh: 炸面包是一种炸面团食品。

sentences.en: It is usually eaten with sour cream and cheese.
sentences.zh: 通常搭配酸奶油和奶酪食用。

sentences.hu: A magyar sütemények is nagyon finomak.
sentences.en: Hungarian pastries are also very delicious.
sentences.zh: 匈牙利糕点也非常美味。

sentences.en: March fifteenth is a national holiday in Hungary.
sentences.zh: 三月十五日是匈牙利的国庆节。

sentences.hu: Ez a nap az 1848-as forradalom emléknapja.
sentences.en: This day commemorates the revolution of 1848.
sentences.zh: 这一天是纪念1848年革命的纪念日。

sentences.en: People celebrate in the streets.
sentences.zh: 人们在街上庆祝。

sentences.en: They wear national flags.
sentences.zh: 他们佩戴国旗。

sentences.en: Concerts and performances are held.
sentences.zh: 举办音乐会和演出活动。

sentences.en: August twentieth is Saint Stephen's Day.
sentences.zh: 八月二十日是圣斯蒂芬节。

sentences.hu: Ilyenkor tűzijátékot is rendeznek a Duna felett.
sentences.en: Fireworks are also set off over the Danube on this occasion.
sentences.zh: 届时还会在多瑙河上燃放烟花。

sentences.en: Budapest is a very beautiful city.
sentences.zh: 布达佩斯是一座非常美丽的城市。

sentences.hu: A Duna két részre osztja a várost.
sentences.en: The Danube divides the city into two parts.
sentences.zh: 多瑙河将城市分为两部分。

sentences.hu: Buda a nyugati, Pest a keleti oldalon van.
sentences.en: Buda is on the western side and Pest is on the eastern side.
sentences.zh: 布达在西边，佩斯在东边。

sentences.en: The Parliament building is very impressive.
sentences.zh: 国会大厦非常壮观。

sentences.hu: A Budai Vár is népszerű turistalátványosság.
sentences.en: Buda Castle is also a popular tourist attraction.
sentences.zh: 布达城堡也是热门旅游景点。

sentences.en: The thermal baths are a specialty of the city.
sentences.zh: 温泉浴场是这座城市的特色。

sentences.hu: Évente több millió turista látogat Budapestre.
sentences.en: Several million tourists visit Budapest every year.
sentences.zh: 每年有数百万游客来到布达佩斯。
